fiwon123/ai-document-platform.description: Upload documents, extract and chunk text, generate embeddings (OpenAI or local models), search semantically with pgvector, and ask questions grounded in your documents with source attribution.

fiwon123/ai-code-evaluation-platform.description: AI code evaluation platform validates AI models using problem prompts and user-created tests.

fiwon123/distributed-key-value-store.description: A minimal, educational distributed key-value store, built from scratch in Go with a hand-rolled Raft consensus algorithm.

fiwon123/distributed-task-queue.description: A durable, PostgreSQL-backed distributed task queue in Go — educational, built from scratch.

fiwon123/live-chat-server.description: Real-time chat with a Rust backend and a React + TypeScript client. WebSockets, JWT auth, room-based access control, and message persistence in PostgreSQL.

fiwon123/realtime-leaderboard.description: A real-time leaderboard service — submit score events, read a player's rank, and page through the top of the board.
